mapper.insert: insert into chat_messages(sender_id, receiver_id, message_type, content, file_id, send_time, read_status) values (#{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{messageType}, #{content}, #{fileId}, #{sendTime}, #{readStatus})
mapper.update: update chat_messages set read_status=1 where sender_id=#{friendId} and receiver_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: select c.*, u.nickname as nickname,u.avatar as avatar from chat_messages c join users u on c.sender_id=u.id order by c.send_time
